stance_rationale: Forge의 DEFER/HARD_ABORT 결론 자체는 방향상 맞지만, 검증 패키지는 RF-F2/RF-F5/RF-F6/RF-F7/RF-F3를 통과하지 못한다. 특히 weights/alpha_scores/date-range/lockbox/DSR-Harvey/turnover 산식이 서로 맞지 않아 AX-002 harness-valid evidence로 승인할 수 없다.

critical_concerns.description: weights.csv has only 40 sig_dates, not the recommended 60+, and actual range is 2020-08-31 to 2025-09-30 while the package repeatedly claims a 2018-08 to 2021-12 40-month OOS slice. alpha_scores.parquet has no Date/sig_date column, so Date x Ticker x score_* time-series provenance is not verifiable.

monthly_returns.parquet is absent and the available 03_period_returns.csv is sparse over non-contiguous rebalance dates. This blocks a clean walk-forward return audit and makes the stated same-period measurement basis unstable.

No realized CAPM, Carhart-3, Carhart-4, FF5, or FF6 regressions with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR are emitted. Baseline DSR penalty is also absent, so the comparison is not same-period/same-cost/same-DSR fair.

run_all.R computes turnover as mean monthly sum(abs(delta_w)) x 12 and does not implement the role-required round-trip x2 convention. Because reported turnover is close to the 600% hard cap, this is not a harmless formula detail.

The chart shows strategy values through 2024-2025 but no lockbox split, vertical lockbox marker, Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined reporting, or frozen-extension evidence. Using sealed lockbox-period dates without explicit lockbox handling is a process-future-information risk.

covariance.parquet is only a per-date summary with cond_num/det/shrinkage, not the covariance matrices or min eigenvalue audit. Sidecar sigma_per_sigdate RDS matrices pass PSD and cond <=100, but the requested parquet artifact itself cannot prove PSD.

After G1 hard abort on recall 0.089, Forge still labels a selected candidate and marks all 16 candidates Pareto=true. Diagnostic exploration is acceptable only if clearly separated from candidate selection; otherwise it weakens AX-001 conditional-defense admission discipline.

supporting_arguments: Current md5sum prefixes match the package audit for alpha/risk/optimization packages.
weights.csv portfolio constraints pass on the emitted 40 dates: 20 names per date, sums equal 1, no negative weights, no weight above 20%.
sigma_per_sigdate contains 40 RDS matrices with min eigenvalue about 0.00125 and max condition about 19.89, so the sidecar covariance realization is numerically benign.
Forge does not try to ADMIT the strategy; G1 recall failure, cor near 1.0, SR drag, and same-period domination are stated explicitly.
equity_curve.png, annual_returns.png, and oos_zoom_chart.png are present.
unresolved_disputes: Why the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_003 path is absent while artifacts are under stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_003.
Whether the intended OOS window is 2018-08 to 2021-12 or the emitted 2020-08 to 2025-09 schedule.
Whether 2024-2025 lockbox dates were authorized for Forge measurement before Judge S6 lockbox opening.
Whether xgboost and nnet substitutions are acceptable replacements for the specified LightGBM and Set-Sequence/PyTorch stages.
Whether G1 HARD_ABORT should stop candidate ranking entirely or allow a clearly labeled diagnostic-only postmortem.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that this 40-date alpha-only A-option run is a valid walk-forward Forge measurement; the emitted artifacts contradict the claimed OOS range, omit Date in alpha_scores, omit monthly_returns.parquet, and do not separate lockbox-period evidence.
rebuttal_required: Re-emit alpha_scores.parquet as Date or sig_date x Ticker x score_* for every tested signal date.
Produce monthly_returns.parquet and reconcile the 2018-08 to 2021-12 claim with emitted 2020-08 to 2025-09 weights/nav.
Run all five Harvey specs with t_NW, alpha_monthly, and DSR for strategy and baseline under the same candidate penalty.
Fix turnover to the mandated round-trip convention and remeasure cost-adjusted returns against the <600% hard cap.
Add lockbox marker, frozen-extension evidence, and Pre-LB/Lockbox/Combined reports.
Store covariance matrices or min_eig/PSD fields in covariance.parquet, not only sidecar RDS.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The DEFER conclusion is directionally correct, but the Forge evidence is not AX-008-grade because Codex/Architect confirmation is absent and core RF-F verification items remain unresolved.
